subject: Proposed Hosted API commit bump & rate-tier alignment for ScaleWorx
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@scaleworx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0500
Subject: Proposed Hosted API commit bump & rate-tier alignment for ScaleWorx

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the sync yesterday. Per our conversation, ScaleWorx is tracking toward a sustained increase in token volume driven by the new summarization feature launching mid‑Q2. You mentioned procurement would prefer a single monthly commit rather than a variable overage bill.

Current plan: Hosted API, 1.2M token commit / month, Standard rate tier (64k context), default rate limit 150 reqs/min.
Requested: Move to 3.5M token commit / month, upgrade to the High Throughput tier (higher concurrent window) and raise the per‑route rate limit to 500 reqs/min to avoid throttling during batch ingest jobs.

Preliminary commercial offer (subject to legal/admin):
- Monthly committed tokens: 3.5M
- Unit price per 1k tokens (committed): $0.85
- Overage (if any): $1.10 / 1k tokens
- Term: 12 months with quarterly usage review and an automatic re-evaluation clause for +/‑20% sustained variance
- One change: commit upgrades are effective at invoice cycle start following signed addendum

Attached: redwood_commit_addendum_v2.pdf and a pricing workbook with modeled spend across three traffic curves.

Two operational notes:
1) Rate limits and burst windows are configurable per-route; increasing to 500 reqs/min will require a short config change on our side and a brief coordination call to make sure your ingest workers back off gracefully.
2) If you enable prefix caching for summary prompts we can reduce effective token consumption by ~15–25% on recurring queries; Priyom can help with a quick config.

Would you like me to route the addendum to procurement or set up a 30‑minute call with procurement + engineering to iron out billing cadence and rate-limit cutover?

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0183

Attachments: redwood_commit_addendum_v2.pdf (PDF), 2026_Q2_commit_pricing_sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@scaleworx.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@scaleworx.com
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:11:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Proposed Hosted API commit bump & rate-tier alignment for ScaleWorx

Hi Rishi —

Appreciate the clear breakdown. A couple quick questions from procurement and engineering:
- Procurement: Is the unit pricing fixed for the 12‑month term or subject to CPI/market adjustments? Also need to see an addendum we can attach to our PO that lists billing cadence and renewal notice period.
- Eng: Will the 500 reqs/min cap be applied per API key or per account? We run a multi‑tenant ingestion job and want to ensure one noisy job doesn't starve other services.

If we can get those answers I can route to legal/procurement. We prefer commit changes to align with our existing billing month (1st of the month) — can you confirm effective date mechanics?

Thanks,
Olivia
Head of Platform Engineering | ScaleWorx
olivia.park@scaleworx.com

On Sat, Feb 14, 2026 at 3:02 PM Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai> wrote:

Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Proposed Hosted API commit bump & rate-tier alignment for ScaleWorx

Hi Olivia —

Answers inline:
- Pricing: The committed unit price is fixed for the 12‑month term in the addendum. The commercial team will include an explicit clause about market adjustments (we can exclude CPI) but standard practice here is fixed committed pricing for the duration.
- Rate limit scope: The 500 reqs/min is applied at the account level per API key group (not per individual API key). We can create separate API key groups for different teams if you want isolation. That prevents one tenant from affecting another and preserves headroom for critical routes.
- Effective date: Per our standard, upgrades take effect at the start of your next billing cycle after the signed addendum is received. If you sign by Feb 20 we can make the change on Mar 1. If procurement needs an earlier effective date we can discuss proration.

Action items I'd propose:
1) I will send a contract addendum (signed by Redwood) with explicit billing cadence and renewal notice (included in the attached PDF).
2) Priyom can jump on a 30‑minute technical call with your infra team to map API key groups and plan the rate‑limit cutover.
3) Marissa will follow on the PO and invoicing flow to align payment terms.

Are you available Thurs 18th 10:00–10:30 AM ET for the technical+procurement call?

Best,
Rishi

---
Rishi Malhotra | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@scaleworx.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Proposed Hosted API commit bump & rate-tier alignment for ScaleWorx

Hi Olivia —

Saw Rishi's note and attached addendum. From a contracting perspective:
- We can accept a standard PO referencing the addendum.
- Payment terms: Net 30 standard; we can consider Net 45 for enterprise with credit check — let us know if that is needed.
- Redlines: I flagged one language item (Section 3.2, data retention) for legal to review; that won't affect pricing but may add 2–3 business days.

I'll stand by to receive the PO once procurement is ready. If you want, I can move the billing contact over to our billing team in parallel so we don't block the effective date.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: none (contract addendum shared by Rishi)

From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@scaleworx.com>

Cc: procurement@scaleworx.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 11:20:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Proposed Hosted API commit bump & rate-tier alignment for ScaleWorx

Thanks — this is helpful. Procurement has requested the following so we can issue the PO:
1) Final addendum PDF with signature block (we received the draft; please send final signed copy).
2) Billing contact and remit-to email for invoicing.
3) Confirmation that the 500 reqs/min is account-level and that Redwood will create a second API key group for our analytics team (we'll send a list of team aliases).

We can target Mar 1 effective date provided the signed addendum is in place by Feb 20 and the data retention redline is resolved. I'll put procurement on copy of any updates — procurement@scaleworx.com.

I'll prepare the PO once we have the signed addendum and billing info. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

—Olivia
